newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 6.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Front-page story carries the full text of a speech delivered by President Jiang Zemin last September on eradicating poverty by the end of the century.

The State Council, or cabinet, will step up efforts to reform three major state-owned holding companies -- the China Non-Ferrous Metals Industry Corp, the China National Petrochemical Corp and the Chinese General Company of Aeronautics Industry.
Sales of Qingdao Hai'er Refrigerator Co Ltd reached 6.0 billion yuan ($723 million) in 1996.
The business turnover of the China National Metals and Minerals Import and Export Corp topped $4.9 billion in 1996.
China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications hopes to record a 30 percent increase in revenues this year despite a reduction in fixed asset investment.
